Nearest measured pose within 11 ms; local equatorial WGS84 tangent approximation
GNSS has no fix-validity flag; proto3 scalar zero defaults do not attest field presence
IMU force checks cover free-fall and settled magnitudes, not general rotated dynamics or impact calibration
Pressure reference is world z=0; GNSS origin elevation deliberately zero
Pinned prebuilt image retained; source rebuild provenance remains unresolved from Phase 74B
